DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cran_mirror:
- https://cloud.r-project.org
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  r-base:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
r_base:
- '4.4'

about.description:
Draw images easily, set up a plot with an image, specify
where that image should be placed. Image plot by default
reflects the index of the image data itself, or can be
specified in simple extent terms 'xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax'. Numeric
matrices, integer arrays, byte arrays, character arrays, and
native rasters are (or will be) supported. A combination of
image() and rasterImage() from the 'graphics' package with
their good features in one place.
about.summary: Draw Images of Raster Data and Related Adornments

name: r-ximage
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.0"

package:
  name: r-ximage
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url:
    - ${{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/ximage_${{ version }}.tar.gz
    - ${{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/ximage/ximage_${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b20a5cb8b1d0855913222b3e045e14c302f0d62bace29af27c218e640950e11e

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: generic
  script: ${{ R }} CMD INSTALL --build .

requirements:
  host:
    - r-base
  run:
    - r-base

tests:
  - r:
      libraries:
        - ximage
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - r-testthat >=3.0.0
    script:
      - Rscript -e "testthat::test_file('tests/testthat.R', stop_on_failure=TRUE)"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/hypertidy/ximage
  summary: Draw Images of Raster Data and Related Adornments
  description: |-
    Draw images easily, set up a plot with an image, specify
    where that image should be placed. Image plot by default
    reflects the index of the image data itself, or can be
    specified in simple extent terms 'xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax'. Numeric
    matrices, integer arrays, byte arrays, character arrays, and
    native rasters are (or will be) supported. A combination of
    image() and rasterImage() from the 'graphics' package with
    their good features in one place.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - ${{ PREFIX }}/lib/R/share/licenses/MIT
    - LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/hypertidy/ximage
  documentation: https://hypertidy.github.io/ximage/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - mdsumner
